title: Herbs in Veggie Beds Benefit Your Garden
reason: Discusses the benefits of planting herbs in vegetable beds and provides specific examples.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of incorporating herbs into vegetable beds.

subtasks.text: Describe how sage can repel bean beetles when planted with beans.
Mention that chives improve the texture and taste of carrots.

tasks.task: Provide examples of herbs that improve the flavor of tomatoes.

subtasks.text: State that basil improves the flavor of tomatoes when planted with them.

tasks.task: Highlight how certain herbs attract pollinators and repel pests.

subtasks.text: Note that lavender, oregano, and peppermint attract pollinators and repel pests.
Emphasize the importance of ensuring that herbs have the same soil and water needs as other plants in the bed.
Mention that there are some herbs that should not be planted together.
